name: 铝粉
defs:
<!-- 粉末堆的金属质感渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="mg-alu" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
          <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#e9ecef"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#adb5bd"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 星芒的强烈发光滤镜
             注意：filter 默认滤镜区域只有 bbox 的 ±10%，小图元（如 r=2 的圆）套上
             stdDeviation=2 的模糊会被硬裁出方形接缝 —— 必须把区域放宽。 -->
        <filter id="glow-alu" x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%">
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2" result="blur"/>
          <feMerge>
            <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
            <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
          </feMerge>
        </filter>
body:
<!-- 粉末堆主体 -->
      <path d="M16 46 C22 36, 28 34, 32 34 C36 34, 42 36, 48 46 L44 54 C36 58, 28 58, 20 54 Z"
            fill="url(#mg-alu)"
            stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.9)"
            stroke-width="1.2"
            stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <!-- 粉末表面的颗粒纹理（暗示这是粉末而不是光滑的石头） -->
      <circle cx="26" cy="44" r="1.2" fill="#fff" opacity="0.7"/>
      <circle cx="34" cy="42" r="1" fill="#fff" opacity="0.6"/>
      <circle cx="38" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#fff" opacity="0.8"/>
      <circle cx="28" cy="50" r="0.8" fill="#fff" opacity="0.5"/>
      <path d="M24 48 Q28 46 32 48" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.4"/>
      <!-- 核心大星芒（位于粉末堆正上方，强烈发光） -->
      <path d="M32 12 L34 20 L42 22 L34 24 L32 32 L30 24 L22 22 L30 20 Z"
            fill="#ffffff"
            filter="url(#glow-alu)"/>
      <!-- 左侧小星芒（错落分布，增加灵动感） -->
      <path d="M18 28 L19 32 L23 33 L19 34 L18 38 L17 34 L13 33 L17 32 Z"
            fill="#ffffff"
            opacity="0.85"/>
      <!-- 右侧微小闪光点 -->
      <circle cx="46" cy="20" r="2" fill="#ffffff" filter="url(#glow-alu)"/>
      <circle cx="42" cy="14" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.7"/>

name: 月光花瓣
defs:
<!-- 环境光晕：同色径向渐变，极低透明度，让图标在深色 UI 上自然浮起 -->
        <radialGradient id="mg-moon-amb" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#cfe3ff" stop-opacity="0.22"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#cfe3ff" stop-opacity="0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <!-- 花瓣：光从左上打下来，尖端最亮、根部压深 -->
        <linearGradient id="mg-moon-petal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.7" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
          <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#e2edff"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b7cffb"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 花心：径向高亮 -->
        <radialGradient id="mg-moon-core" cx="42%" cy="35%" r="70%">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#cfe3ff"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <!-- 拖尾：越往下越透明，模拟消散。
             必须用 userSpaceOnUse —— 中间那条竖直拖尾 x 恒为 32，包围盒宽度为 0，
             用默认的 objectBoundingBox 渐变会因为包围盒退化而整条不渲染。 -->
        <linearGradient id="mg-moon-trail" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="0" y1="30" x2="0" y2="58">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#dceaff" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
          <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#cfe3ff" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#cfe3ff" stop-opacity="0"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 自发光（魔法原料必须微微发光）；滤镜区域放宽，避免模糊被裁出硬边 -->
        <filter id="glow-moon" x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%">
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.6" result="blur"/>
          <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
        </filter>
body:
<!-- 垂落的拖尾：起笔藏在花瓣底下，从花底轮廓处自然垂出（避免断口和划痕感） -->
      <g fill="none" stroke="url(#mg-moon-trail)" stroke-linecap="round" filter="url(#glow-moon)">
        <path d="M28 30 C24 38, 21 48, 22 58" stroke-width="2.2"/>
        <path d="M36 30 C40 38, 43 48, 42 58" stroke-width="1.9"/>
        <path d="M32 28 C32 41, 32 51, 32 58" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      </g>

      <!-- 花朵：五片花瓣绕花心均分 -->
      <g transform="translate(32,21)" filter="url(#glow-moon)">
        <g fill="url(#mg-moon-petal)" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.8)" stroke-width="1" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <path d="M0 -2.5 C4.2 -6.7, 5.5 -12.6, 0 -16 C-5.5 -12.6, -4.2 -6.7, 0 -2.5 Z" transform="rotate(0)"/>
          <path d="M0 -2.5 C4.2 -6.7, 5.5 -12.6, 0 -16 C-5.5 -12.6, -4.2 -6.7, 0 -2.5 Z" transform="rotate(72)"/>
          <path d="M0 -2.5 C4.2 -6.7, 5.5 -12.6, 0 -16 C-5.5 -12.6, -4.2 -6.7, 0 -2.5 Z" transform="rotate(144)"/>
          <path d="M0 -2.5 C4.2 -6.7, 5.5 -12.6, 0 -16 C-5.5 -12.6, -4.2 -6.7, 0 -2.5 Z" transform="rotate(216)"/>
          <path d="M0 -2.5 C4.2 -6.7, 5.5 -12.6, 0 -16 C-5.5 -12.6, -4.2 -6.7, 0 -2.5 Z" transform="rotate(288)"/>
        </g>
        <!-- 花心 + 高光 -->
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="3.9" fill="url(#mg-moon-core)"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="1.5" fill="#fff"/>
      </g>

      <!-- 花瓣高光点缀（短、贴边，避免读成划痕） -->
      <path d="M28.5 14 C27.8 15.2, 27.5 16.4, 27.8 17.6" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.85"/>
      <circle cx="26" cy="29" r="1.2" fill="#fff" opacity="0.7"/>
      <circle cx="38" cy="13" r="1" fill="#fff" opacity="0.55"/>

        <filter id="glow-scale" x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%">
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.7" result="blur"/>
          <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
        </filter>

      <!-- 极简：不加纹理线，靠渐变 + 白描边 + 发光表达体积 -->

name: 雷鸟羽毛
defs:
<!-- 环境光晕：同色径向渐变 -->
        <radialGradient id="mg-bolt-amb" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b388ff" stop-opacity="0.24"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b388ff" stop-opacity="0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <!-- 紫电渐变：亮紫 → 紫 → 深紫，光从左上打下来 -->
        <linearGradient id="mg-lightning" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.8" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f2ecff"/>
          <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#c9a8ff"/>
          <stop offset="72%" stop-color="#b388ff"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7b2cbf"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 发光：挂在未缩放的组上，滤镜区域放宽 -->
        <filter id="glow-lightning" x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%">
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2" result="blur"/>
          <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
        </filter>
body:
<!-- 闪电：沿用 32 视图原坐标，整体 ×2 放进 64 画布 -->
      <g filter="url(#glow-lightning)">
        <g transform="translate(-1,0) scale(2)">
          <path d="M19.4 3.4 9 17.6h6.4L13.4 28.6 24 13.6h-6.6Z" fill="url(#mg-lightning)" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.85)" stroke-width="0.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
          <path d="M12.4 15.6 17.6 8" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="0.7" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
        </g>
      </g>

name: 影猫皮毛
defs:
<!-- 环境光晕：同色径向渐变 -->
        <radialGradient id="mg-cat-amb" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8d99ae" stop-opacity="0.24"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8d99ae" stop-opacity="0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <!-- 猫头渐变：冷灰，光从左上打下来 -->
        <linearGradient id="mg-cat" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.85" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#939eb3"/>
          <stop offset="52%" stop-color="#565d72"/>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2b2d42"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 发光：挂在未缩放的组上，滤镜区域放宽 -->
        <filter id="glow-cat" x="-100%" y="-100%" width="300%" height="300%">
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.8" result="blur"/>
          <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
        </filter>
body:
<!-- 猫头剪影：沿用 32 视图原坐标，整体 ×2 放进 64 画布 -->
      <g filter="url(#glow-cat)">
        <g transform="translate(0,0.8) scale(2)">
          <!-- 头部轮廓（去黑边，改半透明白） -->
          <path d="M7.2 12.4 6.4 4 13.4 8.2a13 13 0 0 1 5.2 0L25.6 4l-.8 8.4c.8 1.4 1.2 3 1.2 4.6 0 6-4.6 10.2-10 10.2S6 23 6 17c0-1.6.4-3.2 1.2-4.6Z" fill="url(#mg-cat)" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.75)" stroke-width="0.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
          <!-- 左脸高光 -->
          <path d="M9.6 11.6c-.9 2-1.2 4.3-.7 6.6" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="0.7" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.35"/>
          <!-- 眼睛：原黑色在深底上不可见，改自发光冷白；纵向拉长 1.2 倍更接近猫眼 -->
          <g transform="translate(0,17.6) scale(1,1.2) translate(0,-17.6)">
            <path d="M10.6 17.6c0-1.4.8-2.4 2-2.4s2 1 2 2.4c0 1.6-.8 2.6-2 2.6s-2-1-2-2.6Zm6.8 0c0-1.4.8-2.4 2-2.4s2 1 2 2.4c0 1.6-.8 2.6-2 2.6s-2-1-2-2.6Z" fill="#e6edfb"/>
          </g>
        </g>
      </g>
